**Job Description:** Sr. Scrum Master
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

We are seeking an experienced Sr. Scrum Master to support U.S.\-based business partners and collaborate with global technical teams to deliver enterprise technology initiatives successfully. This role combines agile facilitation, project coordination, stakeholder management, and cross\-functional leadership to ensure alignment between business priorities and technical execution.
  
  

The ideal candidate will be highly organized, proactive, and skilled at driving clarity across distributed teams. This individual will help teams plan, execute, and improve delivery while maintaining strong communication across U.S. business stakeholders and global technical contributors.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Scrum Master Responsibilities
  
  

Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  
Coach teams on Agile principles, Scrum practices, and continuous improvement.
  
Remove blockers and help the team maintain delivery momentum.
  
Support team health, collaboration, transparency, and accountability.
  
Track sprint progress and help ensure commitments are understood and met.
  
  

Project Management Responsibilities
  
  

Plan, coordinate, and manage project workstreams from initiation through delivery.
  
Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and action logs.
  
Monitor risks, issues, decisions, and escalation paths.
  
Coordinate across multiple teams, time zones, and functional groups.
  
Support status reporting, executive updates, and governance meetings.
  
Ensure project scope, schedule, and deliverables remain aligned to business priorities.
  
  

Business and Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

Serve as a primary point of contact for U.S. business partners.
  
Translate business needs into actionable delivery plans for global technical teams.
  
Facilitate alignment between business stakeholders, technical leads, and delivery teams.
  
Communicate progress, risks, and changes in a clear and timely manner.
  
Support expectation management and help ensure stakeholder satisfaction.
  
  

Global Team Coordination
  
  

Work effectively with offshore and distributed technical teams across different time zones.
  
Coordinate handoffs, dependencies, and delivery sequencing across regions.
  
Promote shared understanding of priorities, requirements, and deadlines.
  
Ensure communication is consistent and actionable across global teams.
  
Help reduce friction caused by geographic, cultural, or scheduling differences.
  
  

Required Qualifications
  
  

5\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Project Manager, or hybrid delivery role.
  
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, Scrum practices, and project management principles.
  
Experience supporting U.S. business stakeholders in a technology or enterprise environment.
  
Experience working with global or offshore technical teams.
  
Excellent facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  
Strong ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and dependencies.
  
Experience using project and Agile tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, MS Project, or similar.
  
Proven ability to drive clarity, accountability, and delivery in complex environments.
  
  

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

Certification such as Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), PMP, or equivalent.
  
Experience in enterprise software, digital products, or IT transformation programs.
  
Familiarity with software development lifecycle and technical delivery processes.
  
Experience supporting global delivery models and distributed agile teams.
  
Strong executive communication and presentation skills.
  
  

Core Competencies
  
  

Agile facilitation
  
Project planning and execution
  
Cross\-functional leadership
  
Stakeholder management
  
Risk and issue management
  
Global team coordination
  
Clear and concise communication
  
Problem solving and critical thinking
  
Continuous improvement

title: Global Clinical Operations AI Product Director
description:
### **Summary**

\#LI\-Hybrid  

  

Location: Hyderabad, India  

  

Relocation Support: This role is based in Hyderabad, India. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this position; please only apply if accessible and authorized to work in this location.  

  

This is a Hybrid role with a requirement of 12 days per month in office.  

  

Artificial Intelligence is creating new opportunities to transform how clinical trials are planned, executed, and delivered. As Global Clinical Operations AI Product Director, you will translate complex business challenges into practical, scalable AI solutions that improve productivity, quality, and cycle times across clinical development. Working at the intersection of clinical operations, technology, and business strategy, you will guide products from concept through adoption, ensuring they are compliant, user\-focused, and capable of delivering measurable value. This role is focused on AI enablement, transformation, and delivery across Global Clinical Operations.
### **About the Role**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify clinical operations challenges and translate them into high\-value Artificial Intelligence (AI) opportunities and product concepts.
* Define use cases, scope, value hypotheses, and requirements for prioritized products within the Global Clinical Operations AI portfolio.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, vendor solutions, and enterprise capabilities to inform product direction and design.
* Bridge business stakeholders and technical teams, translating operational needs into clear, actionable functional requirements.
* Lead AI products through design, Minimum Viable Product (MVP), pilot, refinement, scaling, and sustained adoption.
* Ensure solutions are user\-focused, compliant, and aligned with privacy, AI guardrails, and Good Practice (GxP) requirements.
* Drive adoption by validating solutions with users, gathering feedback, monitoring outcomes, and supporting organizational change.
* Partner across Global Clinical Operations, Development AI, Digital, Data and Information Technology (DDIT), Quality, and Compliance.

**Essential Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, life sciences, or a related field, or equivalent relevant business experience.
* At least seven years’ relevant experience in leadership roles
* Experience in product management, digital delivery, Artificial Intelligence (AI) solution delivery, or a closely related discipline.
* Strong understanding of clinical operations, drug development, life sciences, or another highly regulated operating environment.
* Proven ability to translate business needs into clear AI requirements, use cases, product scope, and value propositions.
* Experience delivering products through the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) using Agile or Scrum methodologies.
* Understanding of AI and Machine Learning (ML), model lifecycle concepts, and AI\-enabled workflow design.
* Demonstrated success leading cross\-functional initiatives, navigating complex matrix environments, and delivering measurable operational value.
* Experience in leading product strategy, development, and continuous improvement.


**Desirable Requirements**

* Postgraduate qualification such as a Master of Science (MSc), Master of Business Administration (MBA), or Doctor of Philosophy (PhD).
* Experience enabling AI adoption or organizational change within clinical operations or a Good Practice (GxP) regulated environment.
